_: Defaults for actor-pack.py: an actor is a character an image model draws once and redraws with one change at a time, cut into a pack a film animates by swapping pieces (sketch/actors.js). A spec (projects/<id>/actors/<name>.json) names the character and overrides any key here. Every prompt is here, not in the script. Measured 2026-10-17 on seven models (padel-tactics films/05-history/character/ai/README.md): openai/gpt-image-2.5-sunburst kept a figure as still as any (0.4-1.8 % drift on face edits) at $0.019 a picture with a real transparent background; google/gemini-3-pro-image was steadier still (0.4-0.9 %) at $0.136 and no transparency.

looks.explainer: Flat 2D cartoon character for an animated explainer: bold clean dark outlines of even weight, flat colour fills with one soft shade, big expressive eyes, a big head on a small body (about two and a half heads tall), warm and appealing, like a modern TV cartoon.
looks.storybook: A warm children's picture-book character: soft pencil outlines, gentle watercolour and gouache colour with paper texture, rounded friendly shapes, a big head and small body.
looks.editorial: A clean editorial illustration character: confident thin ink lines, a limited palette of flat colours with a little grain, slightly elongated elegant proportions, like a magazine illustration.
looks.papercut: A character made of layered cut paper: flat shapes of coloured card with crisp scissor edges and a thin shadow between layers, simple rounded features.

base: {describe} Full body, standing, front view, facing the viewer, arms relaxed at the sides, a friendly neutral expression with the mouth closed and the eyes open. The whole figure in frame from the top of the head to the soles of the shoes, with a margin all round. One character alone on a plain background: no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no logos.
edit: This exact picture, identical in every way: the same character, design, proportions, outline, pose, framing, size, position and colours, on the same plain white background. One change only: {change}. Nothing else moves or changes: the head's outline, the hair and anything worn on the head, the body, the hands, the clothes and anything held stay exactly as they are, line for line.
pose: The same character as in this picture: identical design, colours, outfit, proportions and size, drawn at the same scale with the feet at the same place, now {change}. A neutral friendly face with the mouth closed. One character alone on a plain white background: no ground, no cast shadow, no text.

faces.happy: a warm happy smile with the mouth closed, the eyes a little narrowed by the smile
faces.laugh: laughing out loud: the eyes squeezed shut in happy arcs, the eyebrows raised, the mouth wide open
faces.sad: sad: the eyebrows tilted up in the middle, the eyes looking down, the corners of the mouth turned down
faces.angry: angry: the eyebrows pulled down hard into a V, the eyes narrowed, the mouth a tight frown
faces.shocked: shocked: the eyes wide open with small pupils, the eyebrows high up, the mouth a small round 'o'
faces.thinking: thinking: the eyes looking up and to one side, one eyebrow raised, the mouth pressed to one side
faces.smug: smug: half-closed eyes, one eyebrow raised, a lopsided confident smile with the mouth closed
faces.worried: worried: the eyebrows raised and tilted up in the middle, a small wavy nervous mouth

mouths.small: the mouth slightly open, as in the middle of saying 'eh', the teeth just showing
mouths.open: the mouth open wide, as in the middle of saying 'ah'
mouths.round: the lips rounded and pushed forward into a small 'o', as in the middle of saying 'oo'
mouths.wide: the mouth stretched wide with the teeth showing, as in the middle of saying 'ee'

blink: the eyes closed, as in the middle of a blink

poses.wave: waving hello with one hand raised above the shoulder, palm open, the other arm relaxed
poses.point: pointing to the right of the picture with one arm stretched out
poses.present: presenting something to the right of the picture with one open palm turned up
poses.thumbs_up: giving a thumbs up at chest height with one hand
poses.shrug: shrugging with both palms turned up and the shoulders raised
poses.cheer: cheering with both arms raised high above the head
poses.think: thinking with one hand on the chin
poses.turn_right: turned in a three-quarter view towards the right of the picture, arms relaxed
poses.turn_left: turned in a three-quarter view towards the left of the picture, arms relaxed

gate._: the most a redraw may change outside the head, as a share of the figure; over it the redraw is drawn again (up to `retakes` times) and the best kept
